correctness.rationale: After exclusion of zero the finite candidate set concentrates on minimizers of a/p+1/a. On the pronic tie locus the next coefficient difference has sign 2k-3(r+1); when it vanishes the following difference is (r-1)^2/4. Direct substitution proves the remaining exact tie. The block formula agrees with diagonal inversion at empty-part boundaries.
residual_risks: No uniform q cutoff or simultaneous growth result.
